visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a blue t-shirt and glasses stands in an outdoor yard at night, forming a triangle with his hands toward the camera. He explains a 'diamond push-up' challenge. Large Traditional Chinese text overlays introduce the 100-day weight loss plan. (2) He stands on a blue yoga mat in the yard, adjusting his black socks while looking at the camera. He appears ready for physical activity. The camera is static at eye-level, capturing his full body as he prepares. (3) He gets into a push-up position, hands close together. He performs several reps with visible physical strain. His face reddens and sweat becomes visible on his forehead. Text labels count each rep. (4) He struggles with the final reps and eventually collapses onto the blue mat. He removes his glasses to wipe sweat from his face, looking exhausted. Variety-style text bubbles emphasize his spent state. (5) He sits cross-legged on the mat, reviewing a workout plan on a clipboard. He then transitions into a side plank, supporting his weight on one elbow. The camera captures his form from a side angle. (6) He switches to the other side for the plank. After finishing, he sits up and rubs his lower back with his hand, grimacing slightly. A kettlebell is visible on the grass nearby. (7) He stands up, holding the clipboard again to check the next exercise. He is visibly perspiring, with sweat soaking his blue shirt. He speaks toward an offscreen companion who is heard laughing. (8) He performs burpees, jumping vertically and clapping his hands above his head. Each jump is energetic but shows his tiring state. He wears an Apple Watch on his left wrist to track his progress. (9) After the set, he lies flat on his back on the blue yoga mat, limbs spread out. He looks at the camera with a tired smile. Text overlays express his humorous desire to quit. (10) He stands and performs rows using a single black and yellow kettlebell. He bends at the waist, pulling the weight toward his chest. The setting is the dimly lit yard at night. (11) Close-up on his face as he strains to lift the heavy kettlebell. He switches arms and continues the rows. His clothing is soaked with sweat, and his expression is pained but determined. (12) He performs a kettlebell walk, holding the weight high above his head with one arm. He walks across the yard with a slightly awkward, balancing gait. The camera tracks his movement. (13) He finishes the walk and lowers the weight, breathing heavily. He looks relieved. He and the offscreen woman share a laugh about his posture. (14) He performs overhead squats and presses with the kettlebell. He maintains focus on his form despite extreme fatigue. The lighting is artificial from the house's exterior. (15) He checks his Apple Watch and shows the screen to the camera, displaying calories burned. He discusses the results, comparing the exercise burn to a chocolate lava cake he previously consumed. (16) Transition to a clean, brightly lit modern kitchen. He is now wearing a grey t-shirt. He speaks directly to the camera, explaining his plan for a healthy post-workout meal. (17) He prepares ingredients, cutting a block of white tofu into small cubes on a wooden cutting board. He then sprays oil from a green can into a black frying pan. (18) He cracks a brown egg into the small frying pan. The camera shows close-ups of the egg and tofu as they sizzle. He uses a wooden spatula to manage the food. (19) He combines the fried egg, tofu, and chopped Napa cabbage into a larger pot. He pours water from a white mug over the ingredients to create a soup. (20) The camera shows the soup boiling vigorously on a gas stove. He then transfers the meal into a grey bowl. He sits at a wooden table, drinking a beverage and eating the hot soup. (21) He tastes the tofu and broth, nodding in satisfaction. He talks about the flavor profile, describing it as light but flavorful. He finishes the entire bowl of soup. (22) A short 2D animation plays, showing a boy lying on the ground and a girl standing over him, representing the video's two participants.
